subject: API stability & escrow request — Orchid Works integration
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@orchid-works.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@orchid-works.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: API stability & escrow request — Orchid Works integration

Hi Marcus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the integration looked promising and our product team is targeting a November GA for the Orchid CRM connector. Before we commit to the integration milestone we'd like to lock in a few operational guarantees from Redwood:

- A version-pin option for the inference runtime (we need to avoid surprise model/behavior changes mid-Q4).
- A documented fallback policy if a pinned model becomes incompatible (what variant will we fall back to?).
- An option for a version escrow or preserved SDK build that our engineering team can reference if Redwood performs a breaking change.

Our security/commercial folks also want to understand the timeline you require for deprecation notices. Orchid's procurement will ask for a minimum of 120 days for any major breaking changes; if you have a standard policy please share.

I've attached a short integration plan and a preliminary commercial SOW. Can we schedule a 45-minute technical + commercial sync this week to discuss the mechanics and any implementation constraints? Ideally Marcus + a runtime engineer would join.

Attachments: orchid-integration-plan.pdf, orchid-sow-draft.pdf

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships | Orchid Works
elena@orchid-works.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@orchid-works.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: API stability & escrow request — Orchid Works integration

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the materials. Appreciate the timeline context. Short answers up front, with proposed next steps below.

1) Version pinning: we can offer a runtime "pin" on Dedicated/Dedicated-like instances where you reference a specific model/artifact (e.g. redwood/gpt-opt:2026-06-12). That pin prevents automatic drift for requests routed to that tenancy.

2) Fallback policy: our standard fallback is to route to the most behavior-compatible variant in the same family; we can make that explicit for you (we'd recommend: fallback -> redwood/gpt-opt:stable-compat -> redwood/gpt-opt:stable). I will confirm exact image tags with Jonas.

3) Escrow/preserved SDK: we have a partner escrow process (legal + engineering) where we snapshot the served model artifact and a minimal runtime shim. This is typically gated by contract and limited to the committed cadence. We can provide a managed escrow or provide you a signed bundle for your internal reference.

4) Deprecation window: our default is 90 days for major breaking changes; for strategic ISV relationships we can extend to 180 days by agreement.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll attach a short mutual action plan (draft) capturing items above and owners.
- Tech sync: Thu 08/20 at 10:00 PT (Marcus + Jonas + your eng lead).
- Commercial: Vanessa to coordinate SOW/escrow terms with your contracts team (CC'd).

I'll attach MA-ORCHID-draft.docx with milestones and a short checklist for the runtime pin. If that looks good, Vanessa can line up a contract addendum for the extended deprecation window and escrow terms.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: MA-ORCHID-draft.docx

From: Elena Park <elena@orchid-works.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, contracts@orchid-works.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: API stability & escrow request — Orchid Works integration

Marcus — perfect, thanks for the rapid turnaround. A few clarifying questions before the sync: 

- When you say "managed escrow" can you outline what is included (artifact, minimal runtime, hash verification, support window)?
- Will the runtime pin be a tenant-level config or can it be set per-integration (we need per-customer control inside Orchid).
- Can you confirm whether extended deprecation (180 days) is billable or included as part of a committed partner SLA? Orchid is evaluating predictable unit economics.

Contracts: contracts@orchid-works.com will coordinate with Vanessa on the SOW and escrow language. We'll bring a commercial anchor to the call so we can decide on credits vs. added fees.

Forwarding our internal note to Vanessa for visibility: 
> Orchid product team needs fallback to be deterministic otherwise customers will see behavioral regressions mid-run. We prefer an explicit image tag fallback rather than a semantic alias.

Attaching: orchid-sow-draft.pdf (internal)

Thanks,
Elena

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: API stability & escrow request — Orchid Works integration

Internal note / proposed technical plan (quick):

- Runtime pin behavior: implement as integration-level config (runtime_pin: "redwood/gpt-opt:2026-06-12"). That will be honored by the smart router when the request includes the Orchid connector API key.
- Fallback mechanics: provide a two-step fallback map (primary_tag -> compatibility_tag -> global_fallback). For Orchid I'd suggest: redwood/gpt-opt:2026-06-12 -> redwood/gpt-opt:stable-compat -> redwood/gpt-opt:stable-quant. We'll include a simple compatibility score we compute during nightly canary runs to validate behavior drift.
- Escrow bundle: engineering can produce a signed tarball (model weights checksum, tokenizer, runtime shims, minimal start script, config.json) and store it in our partner vault (accessible with a signed access token). For an on-prem escrow we produce the bundle and Drat a short handoff script.
- Costs: propose 40 engineering hours of migration/validation assistance credited as part of the partner onboarding (we can treat as prepaid credit against professional services). Vanessa — can you confirm budget/credit approval?

If we agree, I'll prepare a 1-page runbook and short test checklist for the kickoff so Orchid can validate behavior in staging.

Jonas Weber
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
